note: Real declared coordination capacity (movements/hour) from each coordinator's published capacity declaration. These are capacity PARAMETERS, not per-flight slot allocations (which EU coordinators don't publish openly). LIS is a widely-cited secondary figure (no open S26 primary). FCO omitted — Assoclearance publishes its parameters behind login.

airports.name: London Heathrow
airports.detail: Arrivals peak 46/hr; departures rolling-hour 45/hr (46 in 15:50–18:05). ≤5 arr & 5 dep per 5-min.

airports.name: London Gatwick
airports.detail: Peak total 57/hr (06:00); R15 max 15; R05 5 dep / 4 arr.

airports.name: London Stansted
airports.detail: Two-way peak 50/hr; R15 max 13; R05 5 dep / 4 arr.

airports.name: Manchester
airports.detail: Dual-runway peak 61/hr (07:00); R15 max 16; R05 5–6 dep.

airports.name: Dublin
airports.detail: Runway peak 57/hr (11:00–12:00 UTC); R10 max 13 (6 arr / 7 dep).
airports.caps: Night (23:00–07:00) 35,672/yr planning cap — under legal challenge, not yet applied as a slot cap.

airports.name: Paris Charles de Gaulle
airports.detail: Rolling-hour caps 73 arr / 78 dep; observed peak total ~112/hr; per-10-min up to 13 arr / 14 dep.

airports.name: Paris Orly
airports.detail: Rolling hour ≈40/hr (max 7 movements over two 10-min periods, 6 in the others).
airports.caps: Statutory annual cap 250,000 ATM (external to this declaration).

airports.name: Munich
airports.detail: Mixed-mode 90/hr; 58 arr / 58 dep; R30 mixed 45; R10 mixed 15.

airports.name: Zurich
airports.detail: 66/hr (max 36 arr / 41 dep); 40 per 30-min; 14 per 10-min. Fixed, non-rolling.

airports.name: Amsterdam Schiphol
airports.detail: Peak rolling-hour by mode: departure-peak 36 arr + 74 dep = 110/hr; arrival-peak 68 arr + 38 dep = 106/hr; off-peak 76/hr. Slots per 5-min.
airports.caps: Season environmental cap 290,261 ATMs; operational 293,226 slots (night 21,290).

airports.name: Lisbon Humberto Delgado
airports.detail: Peak ~38/hr (sub-limits 26 arr / 26 dep), varying up to ~40; 5-min rolling. Plan to raise to 45 by ~2028.
airports.flag: widely-cited ceiling — secondary source, no open S26 primary declaration
